notes.title: Dartmour Alpha Demo 0.8.2
notes.notes:
[p]
I am getting close to finalizing the Steam demo![/p][p]In the meantime, you can try the current build over on Itch.io to get an early look at Dartmour Demo. It’s playable and gives a good feel for the world and systems. Feedback is welcome![/p][p][/p][p]This alpha test is just hosted on Itch.io for now. It’s free to play, and the final release (and full demo) will be through Steam.[/p][p] [/p][h2]
